title: About this project
lede: CIRCA Archive is a fictional registry, built as a design project: an archive interface from an institution that does not exist, and two ways to read it.
whatBody: CIRCA Archive is a worldbuilding and interface project. It presents the records of the Commission for Incident Review and Corrective Action, a continuity that files reports on incidents that should not have happened. Nothing in it is a real agency, and no record describes a real event.
fictionBody: The Commission and its correspondence are invented. The records are authored sample content: they are not canon, and they do not describe real incidents, people, or organizations. Reference numbers, clearance levels, and the citation web are part of the fiction.
editionsBody: The public archive is a server-rendered reading edition: every record has a page of its own, and no client JavaScript is required to read it. The workstation is the interactive edition: records open in a viewer with annotations, a reviewer's assessment, and the records filed against them. It is a preview, and it is optional.
builtBody: The frontend is a Next.js application. Records are authored as Markdown and rendered through one pipeline; the archive pages are prerendered. There is no backend: records, notes, and citations come from files in the project, and nothing entered in the interface is transmitted or stored.
honestyBody: No office, correspondent, organization, or incident on this site exists. Room numbers, reference numbers, and addresses are invented. The site does not accept correspondence, credentials, or personal details.
accessBody: The public archive is text-first. It can be navigated by keyboard, enlarged with the browser's own controls, and read with reduced motion set. Redactions open with a disclosure control, and figures whose images were not supplied are marked as such.
creditsBody: Built as a personal design and worldbuilding project. The interface, records, and artwork in this repository are sample content; see the repository's licence before reusing anything. The site names no real agency and offers no service.
outside: This page is outside the fiction.
